source.stem:
The engine of a motor vehicle develops a large amount of power.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The driving force acting on the vehicle must be large.
The engine must have a very large volume.
The engine must transfer large amounts of energy each second.
The vehicle must be very fast.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Touching any switch is unsafe, even with dry hands during normal use.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A teacher-supervised circuit activity using a cell must not be performed.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A live plug with no visible heating is safe to touch with wet hands.

intelligence.enrichment: Electricity can be dangerous if it is not handled carefully, and the human body conducts electricity; current through the body may cause severe injury or death. unsafe contact with electrical supply or wet switches and plugs -> current can pass through the body -> injury risk The learner correctly applies this rule: Electricity can be dangerous if it is not handled carefully, and the human body conducts electricity; current through the body may cause severe injury or death. Briefly touching household switches or plugs is safe if the person is careful.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: circuits and cells. The student must decide: Decide when an electrical situation is unsafe to handle.
